title: 05 - Devices & Reliability
description: ¿Qué dispositivos están fallando o degradándose? Último valor, estado operativo, alertas y frescura por entidad.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff')

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, domain, event_time, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff')) SELECT count_if(event_time >= localtimestamp - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE OR domain IN ('button', 'event', 'update', 'select', 'number')) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff') AND domain = 'sensor' AND numeric_state IS NOT NULL

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, state, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff') AND domain IN ('light', 'switch', 'binary_sensor', 'lock')) SELECT count_if(lower(state) IN ('on', 'open', 'unlocked', 'active', 'detected')) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, domain, state, quality_flag, event_time, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff')) SELECT count_if(quality_flag <> 'ok' OR lower(state) IN ('unknown', 'unavailable') OR (domain NOT IN ('button', 'event', 'update', 'select', 'number') AND event_time < localtimestamp - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE)) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1
SELECT CAST(to_unixtime(max(event_time)) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff')

panels.title: Estado actual de todas las entidades
panels.description: Una fila por entidad activa del inventario, con su KPI más reciente y correspondencia con la entidad Matter real.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff')) SELECT CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id)) LIKE '%borja%' THEN 'Sensor Habitación 3' WHEN lower(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id)) LIKE '%padres%' THEN 'Sensor Habitación principal' WHEN lower(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id)) LIKE '%chicas%' THEN 'Sensor Habitación 2' ELSE replace(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id), '[SYN] ', '') END AS dispositivo, coalesce(element_at(attributes, 'original_entity_id'), entity_id) AS entidad, CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(element_at(attributes, 'area_id'), '')) LIKE '%borja%' THEN 'Habitación 3' WHEN lower(coalesce(element_at(attributes, 'area_id'), '')) LIKE '%padres%' THEN 'Habitación principal' WHEN lower(coalesce(element_at(attributes, 'area_id'), '')) LIKE '%chicas%' THEN 'Habitación 2' ELSE coalesce(element_at(attributes, 'area_id'), 'sin_area') END AS estancia, domain AS tipo, CASE WHEN numeric_state IS NOT NULL THEN concat(format('%.2f', numeric_state), coalesce(concat(' ', unit), '')) WHEN lower(state) = 'on' AND domain = 'binary_sensor' THEN 'Abierta / detectado' WHEN lower(state) = 'off' AND domain = 'binary_sensor' THEN 'Cerrada / normal' WHEN lower(state) = 'on' THEN 'Encendido' WHEN lower(state) = 'off' THEN 'Apagado' WHEN lower(state) = 'unlocked' THEN 'Abierta' WHEN lower(state) = 'locked' THEN 'Cerrada' WHEN domain IN ('button', 'event') THEN 'Evento recibido' ELSE state END AS valor_actual, CASE WHEN domain IN ('button', 'event') THEN 'EVENTO' WHEN quality_flag <> 'ok' THEN upper(quality_flag) WHEN domain IN ('update', 'select', 'number') AND event_time >= localtimestamp - INTERVAL '70' MINUTE THEN 'OK' WHEN event_time >= localtimestamp - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE THEN 'OK' ELSE 'DESACTUALIZADO' END AS estado_dato, event_time AS ultima_actualizacion FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY estancia, tipo, dispositivo

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, friendly_name, numeric_state, event_time, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff') AND domain = 'sensor' AND unit = '°C' AND numeric_state IS NOT NULL) SELECT replace(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id), '[SYN] ', '') AS metric, CAST(numeric_state AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY value DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, friendly_name, numeric_state, event_time, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff') AND domain = 'sensor' AND unit = '%' AND numeric_state IS NOT NULL) SELECT replace(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id), '[SYN] ', '') AS metric, CAST(numeric_state AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Puertas, cerraduras y sensores de apertura

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff')) SELECT replace(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id), '[SYN] ', '') AS dispositivo, coalesce(element_at(attributes, 'area_id'), 'sin_area') AS estancia, CASE WHEN lower(state) IN ('on', 'open', 'unlocked', 'active', 'detected') THEN 'ABIERTA / ACTIVA' WHEN lower(state) IN ('off', 'closed', 'locked', 'inactive', 'clear') THEN 'CERRADA / NORMAL' ELSE upper(state) END AS estado, event_time AS ultima_actualizacion FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND (domain = 'lock' OR domain = 'binary_sensor' OR lower(entity_id) LIKE '%puerta%') ORDER BY estancia, dispositivo

WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE (element_at(attributes, 'synthetic') = 'true' OR source = 'sonoff') AND domain IN ('light', 'switch')) SELECT replace(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id), '[SYN] ', '') AS dispositivo, coalesce(element_at(attributes, 'area_id'), 'sin_area') AS estancia, CASE WHEN lower(state) = 'on' THEN 'ENCENDIDO' WHEN lower(state) = 'off' THEN 'APAGADO' ELSE upper(state) END AS estado, event_time AS ultima_actualizacion FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY estancia, dispositivo

panels.title: Estado actual · Sensores ambientales
panels.description: KPI actual de cada sensor ambiental integrado en el flujo completo.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(observation_date) AS d FROM tfm.gold.environment_daily), rows AS (SELECT room_name AS estancia, 'Temperatura' AS medida, CAST(indoor_mean_temperature_c AS DOUBLE) AS valor, temperature_event_count AS eventos, CASE WHEN temperature_event_count > 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'SIN DATOS' END AS calidad, last_indoor_event_time AS ultima_actualizacion FROM tfm.gold.environment_daily, latest WHERE observation_date = latest.d AND indoor_mean_temperature_c IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT room_name, 'Humedad', CAST(indoor_mean_humidity_pct AS DOUBLE), humidity_event_count, CASE WHEN humidity_event_count > 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'SIN DATOS' END, last_indoor_event_time FROM tfm.gold.environment_daily, latest WHERE observation_date = latest.d AND indoor_mean_humidity_pct IS NOT NULL) SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY estancia, medida
